$comment: The envUI 1.0 rename map: every public name of @envsemble/envui 0.x that changed, with its 1.0 name. It is the one source for the codemods (v1-names, v1-classes), the migration guide and the search and manifest aliases. 1.0 re-exports nothing under an old name. A new name with a dot is a part of an ES module namespace: `Menu.Item` is the `Item` part of the `Menu` export.

exports.$comment: Old export name to new name, per entry point. Prop and other types are listed beside their components.

split.$comment: Old components that became several parts: the part follows the value of one prop, which the new part no longer takes.

removed.$comment: Exports that became internal in 1.0, with what to use instead. A `value` is the constant's literal, which a codemod can inline.

MenuDensity.use: Menus have one anatomy in 1.0, and density is gone: the app's scale sizes them, so use ThemeScale for a scale and drop the density.

SurfaceDensity.use: Surface's density is gone in 1.0: give the controls inside a ControlSize with their size prop, or set a ThemeScale with scale on a Theme around the region.

LoadingBar.use: AppShell's loading and loadingLabel props show page progress along the bottom of its topbar; Progress shows the progress of a task.

LoadingBarProps.use: AppShell's loading and loadingLabel props show page progress along the bottom of its topbar; Progress shows the progress of a task.

Toast.use: Show notifications through useToast() inside Toast.Provider. The manual Toast is internal; the `Toast` export is now the namespace of Toast.Provider.

ToastProps.use: Describe a notification with ToastNotification, the argument of useToast().show().

getInitials.use: Avatar shows the initials itself with fallback="initials"; derive initials in the application for custom layouts.

useLinkComponent.use: Render envUI's Link, Button with href, NavList.Item or Menu.Item with href, which use the LinkProvider's component; or read the router's link component in the application.

useSidebarCompact.use: Keep the sidebar's collapsed state in the application through AppShell's collapsed and onCollapsedChange props.

defaultThemeStorageKey.use: The default storage key is the string "env-theme"; pass the same storageKey to createThemeBootstrapScript and ThemePreferenceProvider to change it.

props.$comment: Props of 0.x components that 1.0 removed or changed, per entry point and component, by its 1.0 name. Each literal value of a prop maps to the props that replace it, in its place: an empty object drops the prop, and a replacement prop the element already sets is kept as it is. `report` says what replaces the prop; the v1-props codemod reports it at each use whose value is not listed, such as an expression, and with a value's own `report` at each use of that value. `current` lists a prop's 1.0 values, which it leaves alone without a report, so it can run again over its own output.

compact.report: TextField's compact is gone: fields take the control height by default, and size="sm" gives the small one. For a compact app or region, set scale="compact" on its Theme.

true.report: compact is gone: the field takes the control height, and showLabel={false} keeps its label hidden as compact did. For a compact app or region, set scale="compact" on its Theme.

false.report: compact={false} was the tall floating field, which is variant="floating" now.

false.report: compact={false} was the tall floating field, which is variant="floating" now.

density.report: Select's density is gone: size="sm" gives the small trigger, and every popup has the menus' anatomy. For a compact app or region, set scale="compact" on its Theme.

standard.report: the popup now has the menus' anatomy, with a check mark on the chosen option.

density.report: Combobox's density is gone: fields take the control height by default, size="sm" gives the small one and variant="floating" the tall one. For a compact app or region, set scale="compact" on its Theme.

standard.report: the standard density was the tall floating field, which is variant="floating" now.

density.report: DatePicker's density is gone: fields take the control height by default, size="sm" gives the small one and variant="floating" the tall one. For a compact app or region, set scale="compact" on its Theme.

standard.report: the standard density was the tall floating field, which is variant="floating" now.

Menus have one anatomy in 1.0, at the scale's row height: density is gone. For a compact app or region, set scale="compact" on its Theme.

size.report: NavList.Item's size is gone: items follow the scale. For a compact app or region, set scale="compact" on its Theme.

compact.report: size="compact" is gone: items follow the scale. For a compact app or region, set scale="compact" on its Theme.

density.report: Tree's density is a row density in 1.0: xs, sm (the default, as compact was) or md (as standard was) or lg.
Table's density is a row density in 1.0: xs, sm (as compact was), md (the default, as standard was) or lg.

size.report: Tabs' size is the rail's control size in 1.0: sm (as compact was), md or lg (the default, as standard was).
SegmentedControl's size-as-density is gone: use size="sm", "md" or "lg". compact is sm, and standard is the default.
Pagination's size-as-density is gone: use size="sm", "md" or "lg". compact is sm, and standard is the default.
CopyButton's size-as-density is gone: use size="sm", "md" or "lg". compact is sm, and standard is the default.

classes.$comment: Old class name to new name. An entry also renames every class and custom property that continues it with a hyphen (env-date-time-well becomes env-date-picker-well, --env-notice-tone becomes --env-alert-tone); the longest matching entry wins.

classesWithin.$comment: Class renames that depend on an ancestor, by the ancestor's old class: 0.7's DiffCount labelled itself with the counter's label class, which 1.0's DiffStat names for itself. In a selector that puts the old class inside the ancestor, such as `.env-diff-count .env-counter-label`, the class takes this name instead of the one in classes. Markup is not changed by context: a className is renamed by classes alone.

docs.$comment: Old documentation page slug (docs/components/<slug>.md and the catalogue route components/<slug>) to the new one.

tokens.$comment: Every custom property that envUI 0.x or 1.0’s development defined and 1.0 no longer does, with what replaces it: `to`, the 1.0 custom property, which v1-classes writes in its place (every token takes the --env- prefix, and a few names change beyond it); `value`, the color of a 0.7 fixed color that no token replaces, which v1-classes reports; or `removed`, with `to` what to use instead where there is one, which v1-classes also reports. A `note` says what changed beyond the name. `npm run tokens:build` writes this section from packages/ui/src/generated/token-migration.json.

--color-border-accent-emphasis.note: The translucent edge is the tone’s plain border now, between its muted edge and its solid emphasis.

--color-border-accent-hover.note: The solid edge is the tone’s emphasis now, as a solid fill is; the plain name is its translucent edge.

--color-border-warning-emphasis.note: The translucent edge is the tone’s plain border now, between its muted edge and its solid emphasis.

--color-checkbox.note: Light took the brand’s strong fill, the same color as its emphasis fill there: one role in every theme now.

The role is the scrim itself, 55% opaque: paint it as it is, since a style that applies its own opacity now applies it twice. For the opaque color, write #1f1f1f.

--color-navigation-quiet.note: The quiet navigation item’s rest, which envUI no longer reads; list items have the same fill.

--color-on-checkbox.note: Light took the brand’s strong fill, the same color as its emphasis fill there: one role in every theme now.
